---
pagetitle: "Mallory J. Feldman, PhD"   # Title of the page
toc: false                             # Disable table of contents
bibliography: publications/papers.bib  # Path to your .bib file containing publications
csl: publications/apa.csl              # Citation style file (APA 7th edition)
nocite: |                              # Include all entries in the bibliography, even if not cited in text
  @*
execute:
  echo: false       # Do not show R code in the output
  warning: false    # Suppress warnings in output
  message: false    # Suppress messages in output
---

This page lists all my published works, organized by year of publication. Click a paper’s title to visit the publisher page and access the official version. Use `Abstract` to reveal the summary, and `Citation` for the APA 7th-edition reference.<span style="font-size:0.9rem; opacity:0.8; margin-bottom:0.5rem;">* = co-first authorship</span> 

Code for this page adapted from [Jeffrey Girard](https://affcom.ku.edu/research.html).

```{r Load Libraries}

# RefManageR: read and work with .bib files (BibTeX)
# htmltools: build HTML elements in R
library(tidyverse)
library(RefManageR)
library(htmltools)
```

```{r Define Helper Functions}
# =========================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# =========================================

# `%||%` operator: "if left is NULL or empty, use right"
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0) b else a

# nz_chr: returns NA for blank or empty strings
nz_chr <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x) | trimws(x) == "", NA_character_, x)

# strip_braces: removes curly braces from text (common in BibTeX)
strip_braces <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  y <- as.character(x)
  gsub("[{}]", "", y, perl = TRUE)
}

# fmt_authors_card: formats authors for display on the card
fmt_authors_card <- function(entry) {
  au <- entry$author
  if (is.null(au) || length(au) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  fmt_one <- function(a) {
    fam_vec <- a$family
    if (length(fam_vec)) paste(as.character(fam_vec), collapse = " ") else ""
  }
  
  pieces <- vapply(au, fmt_one, character(1)) # vector of authors
  pieces <- pieces[nzchar(pieces)]           # remove empty names
  if (!length(pieces)) return(NA_character_)
  
  if (length(pieces) == 1) pieces
  else paste(paste(pieces[-length(pieces)], collapse = ", "), "&", pieces[length(pieces)])
}

# get_abstract: retrieves abstract text (or annotation if abstract missing)
get_abstract <- function(entry) {
  abs <- entry$abstract %||% entry$annotation %||% NA_character_
  if (isTRUE(is.na(abs)) || !nzchar(abs)) NA_character_ else abs
}

# normalize_link: converts DOI or URLs into clickable links
normalize_link <- function(x) {
  y <- as.character(x)
  y[is.na(y)] <- NA_character_
  y <- trimws(y)
  y[y == "" | tolower(y) == "na"] <- NA_character_

  ok <- !is.na(y)
  doi_pref <- ok & grepl("^doi:\\s*", y, ignore.case = TRUE)
  y[doi_pref] <- sub("^doi:\\s*", "", y[doi_pref], ignore.case = TRUE)

  bare_doi <- ok & grepl("^10\\.", y)
  y[bare_doi] <- paste0("https://doi.org/", y[bare_doi])

  domain_like <- ok & grepl("^(www\\.|[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,})(/|$)", y)
  no_scheme   <- ok & !grepl("^https?://", y, ignore.case = TRUE)
  needs_scheme <- domain_like & no_scheme
  y[needs_scheme] <- paste0("https://", y[needs_scheme])

  y
}
```

```{r Read BIB}
# =========================================
# READ BIB FILE AND BUILD DATA FRAME
# =========================================

# Read the BibTeX file
bib  <- ReadBib("publications/papers.bib", check = FALSE)
keys <- names(bib)  # each paper has a unique key

# Build a data frame (tibble) with all relevant info
rows <- tibble(
  key   = keys,
  entry = lapply(keys, function(k) bib[k])
) |>
  mutate(
    # Extract and clean title
    title        = map_chr(entry, ~ strip_braces(.x$title %||% "")),
    # Format authors
    authors_card = map_chr(entry, fmt_authors_card),
    # Extract year
    year         = map_chr(entry, ~ {
      y <- .x$year %||% .x$date %||% ""
      if (is.list(y)) y$year %||% "" else as.character(y)
    }),
    # Extract venue (journal, booktitle, or publisher)
    venue        = map_chr(entry, ~ strip_braces(.x$journal %||% .x$booktitle %||% .x$publisher %||% "")),
    # Get abstract
    abstract     = map_chr(entry, get_abstract),
    # Extract keywords
    keywords = map(entry, ~ {
      kw <- .x$keywords %||% NA_character_
      if (is.na(kw) || length(kw) == 0) character(0)
      else strsplit(as.character(kw), ",\\s*")[[1]]}),

    # Process DOI/URL
    doi_url      = map_chr(entry, ~ normalize_link(.x$doi %||% .x$url %||% NA_character_)),
    # Process local PDF file
    pdf_url      = map_chr(entry, ~ {
      f <- .x$file %||% NA_character_
      if (!is.na(f) && length(f) > 0) as.character(f[[1]]) else NA_character_
    })
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(year), title)  # Sort by year descending, then title
```

```{r Build Keyword Sidebar}
# =========================================
# BUILD KEYWORD SIDEBAR
# =========================================

# Get all unique keywords
all_keywords <- rows %>%
  pull(keywords) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

# Build HTML sidebar
sidebar <- tags$div(
  id = "keyword-sidebar",
  style = "
    position: fixed;
    top: 100px;
    right: 20px;
    width: 180px;
    max-height: 80vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: #fafafa;
  ",
  tags$h4("Filter by keyword"),
  
  # Button to show all publications
  tags$div(
    class = "keyword-item",
    style = "cursor:pointer; padding:4px 0; font-weight:600; color:#0b66c3;",
    `data-keyword` = "ALL",
    "Show All"
  ),
  
  # One div for each keyword
  lapply(all_keywords, function(kw) {
    tags$div(
      class = "keyword-item",
      style = "cursor:pointer; padding:2px 0; font-size:0.9rem; color:#0b66c3;",
      `data-keyword` = kw,
      kw
    )
  })
)
```

```{=html}
<!-- =========================================
CLIENT-SIDE KEYWORD FILTERING
========================================= -->
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  // Only enable keyword filtering on desktop
  if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return; // Skip on mobile

  const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.pub-card'));
  const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.keyword-item'));

  items.forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const kw = item.getAttribute('data-keyword');

      if (kw === "ALL") {
        cards.forEach(card => card.style.display = "block");
        return;
      }

      cards.forEach(card => {
        const cardKeywords = (card.getAttribute('data-keywords') || "").split("||");
        card.style.display = cardKeywords.includes(kw) ? "block" : "none";
      });
    });
  });
});
</script>
```

```{css}
/* =========================================*/
/* STYLING FOR PUBLICATION CARDS*/
/* =========================================*/

/* Year group header */
.year-group { margin: 28px 0 8px; }
.year-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; padding-bottom: 2px; }

/* Card layout */
.pub-card {
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 16px 16px 10px 16px;
  margin: 14px 0;
  background: #fff;
}

.pub-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.pub-title a { text-decoration: none; }
.pub-meta  { color: #555; font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }

/* Actions row: Abstract, Citation, PDF */
.pub-actions {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 14px; align-items: center;
  margin-top: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.pub-actions a {
  text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.92rem;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted #999; color: #0b66c3; cursor: pointer;
}
.pub-actions a.external { border-bottom-style: solid; }

/* Toggle area for Abstract/Citation */
.toggle-area {
  display: none; position: relative;
  border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px 44px 12px 12px; background: #fafafa;
  margin-top: 10px; overflow: auto;
}
.toggle-area .panel-label {
  font-size: 0.82rem; color: #333; font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  opacity: 0.85; margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.toggle-area pre { white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; margin: 0; }
.toggle-area .content p { margin: 0 0 0.6em 0; }

/* Copy button */
.copy-btn {
  position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px;
  border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #fff; font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;
}
.copy-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.copy-toast {
  position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 70px; font-size: 0.8rem;
  background: #333; color: #fff; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 6px; display: none;
}

/* Hide auto-generated bibliography at bottom */
div#refs, div#refs + h1, div#refs + h2 { display: none !important; }
```

```{=html}
<!-- 
=========================================
TOGGLE ABSTRACT / CITATION AND COPY BUTTON
========================================= 
-->
<script>
(function() {
  function getCard(el) {
    while (el && !el.classList?.contains('pub-card')) el = el.parentNode;
    return el;
  }

  function showPanel(card, label, html, mode) {
    const area = card.querySelector('.toggle-area');
    const labelEl = area.querySelector('.panel-label');
    const contentEl = area.querySelector('.content');

    const current = area.getAttribute('data-current');
    if (current === mode && area.style.display === 'block') {
      area.style.display = 'none';
      area.setAttribute('data-current', '');
      return;
    }

    labelEl.textContent = label;
    contentEl.textContent = html;
    area.style.display = 'block';
    area.setAttribute('data-current', mode);
  }

  // Toggle Abstract/Citation
  document.addEventListener('click', function(evt) {
    const a = evt.target.closest('a[data-action]');
    if (!a) return;
    const action = a.getAttribute('data-action');
    const card   = getCard(a);
    if (!card) return;
    evt.preventDefault();

    const key = card.getAttribute('data-key');

    if (action === 'abstract') {
      const payloadEl = card.querySelector('.payload-abstract');
      const text = (payloadEl?.textContent || 'No abstract available.').trim();
      showPanel(card, 'Abstract', text, 'abstract');
    } else if (action === 'citation') {
      const ref = document.querySelector('#ref-' + key);
      const html = (ref ? ref.textContent : 'Citation unavailable.').trim();
      showPanel(card, 'Citation', html, 'citation');
    }
  }, false);

  // Copy button functionality
  document.addEventListener('click', function(evt) {
    const btn = evt.target.closest('.copy-btn');
    if (!btn) return;
    const card = getCard(btn);
    const area = card.querySelector('.toggle-area');
    const contentEl = area.querySelector('.content');

    let textToCopy = '';
    const pre = contentEl.querySelector('pre');
    if (pre) textToCopy = pre.textContent;
    else textToCopy = contentEl.innerText;

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(textToCopy).then(() => {
      const toast = area.querySelector('.copy-toast');
      toast.style.display = 'inline-block';
      setTimeout(() => { toast.style.display = 'none'; }, 1200);
    });
  }, false);
})();
</script>
```

```{r Build Publication Cards}
# =========================================
# FUNCTION TO BUILD EACH PUBLICATION CARD
# =========================================

build_card <- function(
  key, entry, title, authors_card, year, venue,
  abstract, doi_url = NA_character_, pdf_url = NA_character_, keywords = character(),...
) {
  # Hidden abstract payload
  payloads <- tags$div(
    style = "display:none;",
    tags$div(class = "payload-abstract", abstract %||% "")
  )

  # Title: clickable if DOI exists
  ttl_node <- if (isTRUE(nzchar(doi_url %||% ""))) {
    tags$div(class = "pub-title", tags$a(title, href = doi_url, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener"))
  } else {
    tags$div(class = "pub-title", title)
  }

  # Authors and venue
  meta <- tags$div(
    class = "pub-meta",
    if (nzchar(authors_card %||% "")) tagList(HTML(authors_card), tags$br()) else NULL,
    if (nzchar(venue %||% "")) tags$em(venue) else NULL
  )

  # Action buttons: Abstract, Citation, PDF
  actions <- tags$div(
    class = "pub-actions",
    tags$a("Abstract", href = "#", `data-action`="abstract", role="button"),
    tags$a("Citation", href = "#", `data-action`="citation", role="button"),
    if (!is.na(pdf_url) && nzchar(pdf_url)) {
      tags$a("[PDF]", href = pdf_url, target="_blank", rel="noopener", class="external")
    }
  )

  # Panel that toggles open when clicking Abstract/Citation
  toggle_panel <- tags$div(
    class = "toggle-area",
    `data-current` = "",
    tags$button(class = "copy-btn", "Copy"),
    tags$span(class = "copy-toast", "Copied!"),
    tags$div(class = "panel-label", "—"),
    tags$div(class = "content")
  )

  # Build the full card
  tags$div(
    class = "pub-card", 
    `data-key` = key, 
    `data-keywords` = paste0(keywords, collapse = "||"),
    ttl_node, meta, actions, toggle_panel, payloads
  )
}

# Get all years (descending)
years <- rows |> distinct(year) |> arrange(desc(year)) |> pull(year)

# Group cards by year
groups <- lapply(years, function(y) {
  subset <- rows |> filter(year == y)

  subset_min <- subset |>
    select(key, entry, title, authors_card, year, keywords, venue, abstract, doi_url, pdf_url)

  cards <- pmap(subset_min, build_card)

  tags$div(
    class = "year-group",
    tags$h2(class = "year-title anchored", id = paste0("y-", y), str_to_title(y)),
    tags$div(cards)
  )
})

# Render the entire page: sidebar + cards
browsable(
  tags$div(
    sidebar,        # Keyword filter sidebar
    tags$div(groups) # Publication cards
  )
)
```
